blocks.name: Wolf (blue-grey wild wolf)
blocks.notes: Cells are on the #47ffbb/#34bc88 checkerboard; the sheet surround is #2a966c and block borders/empty cells are #237f5a - treat all four as transparent. 6 columns of 32x32 cells at x 0-191; the up row has no blink cell (up col 1 empty). 0 standing, 1 blink, 2-3 two-beat trot (2 head low / tail up, 3 head up), 4 airborne leap fully stretched (paw pads showing on the down/up rows), 5 landing crouch. run loops 4-5 as a bounding gallop; pounce plays 4 then 5 once (its lunge attack). Down = coming toward the camera, up = moving away. The baked #000000 shadow sits under the paws and stretches out during the leap; strip it by geometry.

blocks.name: Squirrel
blocks.notes: 16x16 cells, 6 columns x 4 facings at x 208-303, y 32-95; the up row has no blink cell (up col 1 empty). 0 sitting upright with the tail curled up, 1 blink, 2-5 bounding hop in order: 2 lands on the fore-paws, 3 gathers, 4 launches stretched out, 5 airborne with the tail up. #424242 is the eyes and the darkest paw shading; #000000 is only the baked shadow.

blocks.name: Sparrow (small brown bird)
blocks.notes: 16x16 cells, 6 columns x 4 facings at x 320-415, y 32-95; the up row has no blink cell (up col 1 empty). 0 perched, 1 blink, 2-5 wing-beat (2 wings up, 3 wings level, 4 wings down, 5 pixel-identical to 3). It has no ground walk: walk repeats the flight loop. Down/up flight cells are seen from above with the beak pointing the way it flies. No baked ground shadow; #000000 is only the eyes, and beak covers the beak and feet.

blocks.name: Ginger cat
blocks.notes: 16x16 cells, 6 columns x 4 facings at x 432-527, y 32-95; the up row has no blink cell (up col 1 empty). 0 sitting, 1 blink (eyes shut), 2-5 four-beat walk with the tail held up. pink = ears, tail tip and nose highlight; #7b3100 doubles as the fur outline; #000000 is only the baked shadow.

blocks.name: Butterfly
blocks.notes: 8x8 cells, 5 columns x 4 facings at x 208-247, y 112-143 (below the squirrel block). Col 0 is the resting pose (down: wings spread flat; left/right: perched side-on with the wings folded up; up: wings closed). Cols 1-4 are the flutter loop as a wing ping-pong (1 swept wide, 2 raised in a V, 3 closed, 4 pixel-identical to 2). The left and right rows are exact mirror images; down and up are seen from above. walk repeats the flight loop. No baked shadow.
